card.name: Nitric oxide and nitrate phrases in PDE5 labels
card.fires_on: Words just before or inside 'nitrates' and 'nitrites' in PDE5 inhibitor and riociguat labels. It is strongest on the text between 'nitric oxide' and 'GMP' or 'cyclic guanosine monophosphate'.

card.plain: It fires when a label is about to name nitrates, nitrites or nitric oxide donors in the warning about combining them with PDE5 drugs.
